title: First 3 Days: Water, Feed, and Crop Fill Check
content: During the first hours after transport, day-old chicks urgently require fresh drinking water at 20-22°C. Adding glucose and electrolytes relieves transport stress. Feed is distributed on paper flats 2 hours after watering. The key health metric of the first 24 hours is the crop fill test: at 24 hours, 95% of chicks must have soft, pliable crops filled with water and feed.

quiz.question: How long after initial watering should starter crumb feed be offered?
quiz.explanation: Chicks must rehydrate first; starter feed is provided 2 hours after initial watering.
